$metadata.description: Extract regulatory requirements from geothermal ordinances

title: Geothermal Electricity Ordinance Extraction Schema
description: Regulatory requirements for geothermal electricity generation facilities. SCOPE: Geothermal power plants, geothermal production/injection wells for electricity, commercial geothermal energy facilities. EXCLUDE: Geothermal heat pumps (GHP), residential HVAC, direct-use heating/cooling, solar power, wind power, biomass, and other non-geothermal energy technologies. CRITICAL: When extracting from multi-technology renewable energy ordinances, DO NOT extract requirements that apply to solar, wind, biomass, or other technologies. ONLY extract provisions that explicitly mention geothermal or that clearly apply to geothermal based on context.

applies_to_geothermal_electricity.description: Does this document contain provisions regulating geothermal electricity generation?

extraction_approach.description: Document which sections were extracted (geothermal-related) and which were excluded (other technologies/uses). IMPORTANT: If document is a zoning code that lists geothermal as a permitted/conditional use in certain zones, extract ONLY: (1) The geothermal use classification itself, (2) Zone-specific requirements (setbacks, lot size, etc.) from zones where geothermal is allowed. EXCLUDE: Requirements for other land uses (residential, guest houses, manufactured homes, accessory buildings) even if on the same page. For multi-technology renewable energy ordinances, ONLY extract sections that explicitly mention geothermal - DO NOT extract general 'renewable energy' sections that apply to all technologies including solar/wind/biomass. Use format: 'Extracted [sections]; Excluded [sections]'
examples: Extracted Article N.G Sections 6-3N-1 through 6-3N-12 (geothermal); Excluded Section 6-4-12G (solar), Section 6-3C-2 (residential GHP)
Extracted Division 17 (commercial geothermal); Excluded general zoning provisions

Extracted Table of Uses (geothermal power plant classification) and I-A zone site development standards (applicable to geothermal); Excluded R4K residential standards, guest house regulations, manufactured home definitions
No geothermal electricity provisions found; Excluded all sections (document covers only solar and wind)

relevant_sections.description: Ordinance sections regulating geothermal electricity, cited exactly as written (e.g., 'Article N.G Sections 6-3N-1 through 6-3N-12'). Null if none.

state.description: State name exactly as written in document.

county.description: County name exactly as written (keep 'County' suffix if present).

ordinance_code.description: Ordinance number/code/title exactly as written. Null if not stated.

requirements.description: Regulatory requirements applicable to geothermal electricity facilities. One entry per unique requirement. CRITICAL FILTERING: DO NOT add any requirement to this array if it mentions 'solar', 'wind', 'biomass', or other non-geothermal technologies in the ordinance text. Before adding each requirement, verify that it applies specifically to geothermal (not general 'renewable energy'). If uncertain whether a requirement is geothermal-specific, DO NOT extract it.

category.description: Type of regulatory requirement. Use clear, descriptive language based on the ordinance text. For setbacks, use pattern 'Setback from [what]' (e.g., 'Setback from residence', 'Setback from airport'). For other requirements, describe what is regulated (e.g., 'Noise limit during drilling', 'Height limit for power plant'). The examples below are common patterns - adapt them to match the actual ordinance language.

applies_to.description: What entity, equipment, or operation this requirement regulates. Use the actual terminology from the ordinance. IMPORTANT: For zone-based requirements (from zoning codes), specify the zone context if geothermal is allowed in specific zones only (e.g., 'Geothermal power plants in I-A zone', 'Geothermal facilities in A-20 zone'). For universal requirements, use 'Geothermal power plant' or 'All geothermal facilities'. Set to null if the requirement applies broadly or if not specified. ABSOLUTE RULE: This field MUST contain the word 'geothermal' (case-insensitive) OR be null. If the ordinance text mentions 'solar', 'wind', 'biomass', or any other energy technology, DO NOT extract that requirement - skip it entirely.
examples: Geothermal power plants in I-A zone

value.description: The primary quantifiable value extracted from the requirement. EXTRACTION RULES: (1) For numeric requirements → Extract the number without units (e.g., '1320 feet' → 1320). (2) For time ranges → Extract the full range as string (e.g., '7 a.m. to 7 p.m.' or '7 AM - 7 PM'). (3) For yes/no requirements → Extract 'Yes' if requirement exists, describe the answer if it's a specific value (e.g., 'Required', 'Mandatory', 'Not permitted'). (4) For decimal values → Preserve as number or string (0.5). (5) Only use null if the requirement is pure procedural text with no extractable quantifiable element. REMEMBER: This field enables quantitative analysis - extract the KEY value that makes the requirement measurable/comparable across jurisdictions.

unit.description: Unit of measurement SPELLED OUT in full words - NEVER use symbols or abbreviations unless standard. EXTRACTION RULES: (1) For distances → Use 'feet' not "'" or "′", 'meters' not 'm', 'mile' not 'mi'. (2) For noise → Use 'dBA' (standard abbreviation OK). (3) For area → Use 'acres' or 'square feet' spelled out. (4) For currency → Use 'USD' or '$' as written. (5) For time periods → Spell out (e.g., 'days', 'calendar days', 'years'). (6) Use null if: value is null, value is yes/no, or value is a time range. CRITICAL: If document shows "'", "′", or "ft" → extract as 'feet'. If document shows '"' or "″" → extract as 'inches'.

details.description: Complete requirement text verbatim from the ordinance. Include all conditions, exceptions, qualifications, and contextual language. EXTRACTION RULE: Copy the full legal text exactly as written - this preserves the complete regulatory language. The 'value' and 'unit' fields extract the KEY quantifiable elements for analysis, while this field preserves the full regulatory context.

section.description: Ordinance section reference as cited in document (e.g., '6-3N-10-1C', 'Section 10-404(2)(c)'). Null if no section numbering.
